facts.fact: On 5 June 2025 the education authorities and ANADEN officially launched e-Msomo, which allows marks to be entered online and report cards generated automatically and plans a unique identifier per pupil and the handling of transfers; an extension phase with UNICEF Comoros was under study, according to La Gazette des Comores.
La Gazette des Comores reports that the education authorities launched e-Msomo on 5 June 2025 in collaboration with the digital agency ANADEN, with the Minister of National Education speaking for it.
ANADEN's director called the 5 June 2025 launch of e-Msomo and e-Shiyo a significant step in carrying out the Comores Numérique 2028 strategy; the article does not say the strategy names e-Msomo.

systems.tiers: access for pupils, parents and teaching teams; levels not stated

systems.owner: education authorities, with ANADEN; UNICEF support
systems.tiers: online library of approved textbooks for pre-primary and primary pupils

note: The article says what e-Msomo allows, not who enters marks or in how many schools, so no kept, levels or schools fact.
